notes: Each row serves a sourced value for one fact on catalog reads. A replacement row corrects a value models.dev publishes, and applies only while the stored upstream value equals its `replaces` exactly: when models.dev moves to any other value the row stops applying and the upstream value is served, so an override can never hide a later upstream change. An addition row supplies a fact models.dev publishes nothing for, and applies only while the stored upstream row has no such fact: if models.dev ever publishes the key, upstream wins and the row stops applying. Current reads use this compiled file. Every boot records claim changes in fact_override_era; point-in-time (`at_ms`) reads apply the claim in force, guarded against upstream at that instant. First claims start at established_at_ms; later changes and removals start at boot, clamped to the latest boundary when the clock is behind. Provenance-only edits open no era and retain stored provenance. Before a first era or after a tombstone, upstream is served without an override. Every applied row is disclosed in the response's `fact_overrides` list. Supported fact keys and whether a row replaces a value or adds an absent fact are checked by the loader: limit.context, limit.output, capability.server_side_fallback, capability.mid_conversation_system, capability.allowed_fallback_models, route.refusal_fallback.bio, route.refusal_fallback.cyber, capability.reasoning_default, capability.temperature, model.status, rate.output, rate.output_image and rate.cached_input_audio. capability.allowed_fallback_models is Anthropic's Models API list of permitted retry targets for a classifier refusal, in the vendor's order; an empty list is the vendor permitting none. route.refusal_fallback.<category> rows carry only the per-category targets Anthropic has announced in its launch articles. Temperature rows replace a published boolean only; they cannot turn an absent upstream claim into false. For capability.mid_conversation_system, claude-mythos-5-1 and claude-mythos-5 are omitted because the embedded seed does not carry them; Anthropic's cited availability sentence already covers them, so add sourced rows once those anthropic model ids enter the catalog. capability.reasoning_default rows add the effort a vendor documents its own API applying when a request names none, as {"type": "effort", "value": <effort>}, only on the vendor's first-party row; a row applies only while that row's capability.reasoning_options lists the effort in an entry of type effort, and the seed gate refuses a row whose seed options do not. No row is shipped where the vendor documents no default: openai/gpt-6.2-sol and openai/gpt-6.2-astra have none, because OpenAI's pages state only that the API rejects effort none for them and give no default when the field is omitted; the same holds for gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano and the Codex and chat-latest variants. Anthropic documents high for Claude Mythos 5, 5.1 and 5.2, which are omitted because the embedded seed does not carry them.

overrides.notes: The category is the refusal's stop_details.category value `bio`. The articles name Fable 5 only, so the route is not copied to Fable 5.1 or 5.2.
